populationReconciliation.scope: The complete event-card population exposed by the authenticated WOWList Facebook Events surface on the capture date, kept separate from event links shared in preserved WOWList page posts.
populationReconciliation.reconciliationNote: The current Events surface exposed no event cards. Two distinct Facebook event routes were recovered from the complete preserved WOWList page-post corpus; both were externally hosted and are evidence of project-account curation, not WOWList-hosted events. The zero-state does not establish that WOWList never hosted an event or that no older event was removed during page migration or platform change.

publicSafety.note: The public fixture retains the current page-level zero-state and two public event routes recovered from a protected full-population page-post review. It excludes raw post bodies, participant identities, comments, reactions, account identifiers, archive paths, and session state.
